description: Accessibility findings for one page from automated checks in a real headless browser, $0.05 per call (x402; price RULED). Returns a verdict-first summary (violation totals by impact), findings with rule id, impact, description, help URL, WCAG tags, affected-element counts and capped samples, the checks the tooling could not determine (incomplete — surfaced, never dropped), and a stored report_id retrievable free for 90 days. Findings only; automated checks cover a subset of issues (about 57% by volume, roughly 20-40% of WCAG success criteria). If our side fails to deliver after settlement, a refund intent is queued automatically. Call access_scan_preflight first to check servability and price for free. — USDC on Solana via x402 (over MCP: call without payment to get the PaymentRequired challenge, then retry with the payment at _meta["x402/payment"]). HTTP equivalent: POST https://exchangerebel.com/toll/access/scan.

url.description: Public http/https page URL to scan (ports 80/443 only; private/loopback/link-local literals, local names and embedded credentials are refused).
